data.description: Tag-entry input. Wraps a native <input> so its value is a comma-joined CSV (form-submit friendly) while the user sees pill-shaped chips.

data-aed-chips-allowed.description: Comma-separated whitelist. If set, only these values may be added.

data-aed-chips-strict.description: When true with `chips-allowed`, reject any value not on the whitelist (default behavior is to allow but mark).

data-aed-chips-max.description: Maximum number of chips. Further input is rejected.

data-aed-chips-separator.description: Character that finalizes a chip when typed (in addition to Enter).
